title: Service UX and LLDP parsing hardening
acceptance_criteria: LLDP dashboard/service status can populate neighbors when show output is structured instead of table-formatted.
LLDP dashboard/service status can also populate neighbors when show `data` is JSON text.
DHCP create/edit forms default DNS to gateway IP when DNS list is empty while preserving manual override.
DHCP create existing-network mode preloads sensible defaults from selected shared network.
Router Advertisements interface entry offers description-first interface suggestions.
DNS tab rejects partial/invalid domain+host override rows with explicit errors (no silent drops).
DNS backend rejects malformed listen-address/allow-from/name-server/domain values with deterministic HTTP 400 responses.
LLDP/mDNS tabs reject malformed management/domain/service-filter/cache values before API submit.
LLDP interface displays in services views use description-first labels when available.
Load Balancing WAN rules provide guided outbound interface selection and reject unknown interface names before add/apply.
Bridge firewall rule rows display interface labels as Description (ethX) when metadata is available.
System acceleration interface selectors/tables display description-first labels when metadata is available.
Policy Route applied-interface badges display description-first labels when metadata is available.
Load Balancing quick-select controls respect RBAC write permissions (disabled in read-only mode).
Backend and frontend validation gates pass for touched surfaces.
assumptions: Some VyOS builds return LLDP show payloads in non-table structures.
Operators expect visible DNS defaults in DHCP forms instead of submit-time-only fallback.
Interface suggestion lists should remain advisory; free-text must stay available for advanced cases.

tasks.notes: Added structured LLDP parser fallbacks (including JSON-text data payloads), endpoint-level LLDP tests, and DNS input validation in update endpoint.

Added gateway-based DNS defaults, existing-network default prefill behavior, strict DNS override row validation in DNS tab, and LLDP/mDNS pre-submit validation + description-first interface label display in services page.
Ran backend LLDP/system service suites and added endpoint-level LLDP status fallback + DNS validation compatibility tests alongside frontend runtime/build gates.
Added load-balancing outbound quick-select and strict interface validation, plus description-first bridge interface labels in rule rows.
Added description-first interface labels to VPP interface selector and assignment table in System Acceleration.
Policy Route applied-interface badges now render description-first interface labels.
Outbound quick-select controls now disable cleanly in read-only mode to align with RBAC expectations.
